correctness.rationale: For 2m agents, pair-average projections factor through m-dimensional orthonormal incidence embeddings. Contracting A pairs into vertices turns B into cycles; each block is (I+cyclic-shift)/2 and contributes absolute cos(πj/ℓ). Even components contribute one zero; the constant vector removes exactly one nonzero rank dimension. The exponential component counting gives Ewens(1/2), the parity-weighted coefficient PGF, quasi-powers CLT, zero-defect constant and W1 coupling bound. Independent enumeration of all second matchings m≤6 reproduced parity-component histograms; numerical singular values checked m≤4. These finite checks do not establish the asymptotics; the generating-function argument does.
residual_risks: Finite independent experiments corroborate selected identities only; universal assertions depend on reconstructed proof, not experiments.
